candidate.DETERMINISM_RULE: PURE_DETERMINISTIC_NO_RNG: no random source, wall clock, hash-order or floating point; invariant to the order in which the 11 streams are supplied, because the pool is deduplicated and canonically re-ordered by the incumbent before selection
PRE_DRAW_FEATURES_USED: ORIGINAL_RANK: index of t in the incumbent's full total order
candidate.RANK_FORMULA: greedy sequential; at each step select the unselected pool ticket minimizing (MAX_OVERLAP, TOTAL_OVERLAP, ORIGINAL_RANK) lexicographically
candidate.TIE_BREAK_RULE: ORIGINAL_RANK, i.e. the incumbent order (-support_count, -summed_quality, ticket ASC); distinct per ticket, so the induced order is total and no residual tie exists
